plan: reports/weiterentwicklung_2026-10-14/V05_NACHBARHANG_PLAN.md (approved by the user for execution on 2026-10-14)
registered_before: any V0.5 control selection, feature, model or score was computed or viewed
status: exploratory grouped cross-validation on already seen events; no new sealed or external test
question: Can information available before the conservative event time t0 rank the documented positive slope above ten area-uniform, unmatched slope locations 750 m to 10 km around it?

inputs.control_pools: data/v04/cache/control_pools/<event_id>.parquet (6000 area-uniform ring points per event, V0.4 matching config)
inputs.positives: exactly the 423 positives and t0 of the V0.4 dataset; no new positives, no date or position corrections
inputs.independence_unit: V0.4 independence_unit from the partition file (30 units); old development/sealed_test labels kept as provenance only
inputs.rule: V0.4 and baseline artifacts are read only; V0.5 writes only data/v05/, models/v05/, reports/v05/

controls.pool_check: before use: SHA-256 manifest of every pool, 6000 rows, expected columns, x/y regenerated exactly from the V0.4 seed rule, lon/lat consistent with EPSG:31287 x/y, distance in [750, 10000] m
controls.stored_flags_reuse: inventory_clear and inside_austria are reused only if a recomputation with the unchanged inventory snapshot, V0.4 buffer configuration and GISCO boundary reproduces every stored value of every pool; otherwise recomputed with the same rule
controls.pool_id: original row position (0..5999) of the hashed pool file; candidates sorted by pool_id before drawing
controls.seed: int(first 16 hex chars of SHA-256('<event_id>|v05' UTF-8), 16)
controls.draw: one permutation of the eligible pool_ids; walk it in order and accept a point if it is >= 400 m (EPSG:31287 metres) from every accepted point; stop at 10
controls.failure: fewer than 10 selectable controls: the whole event group is excluded; no second seed, no other pool, no rule change
controls.same_t0: every control inherits t0, event_day and time_quality of its positive
controls.freeze: selected controls are frozen in data/v05/controls/ before any feature is computed; later failures exclude the group, never trigger a redraw

features.rule: identical definitions, windows, boundary rules and missing-value rules as config/v04.json; positives and controls computed by the same code in the same request/window
features.inca: hourly value at T admissible iff T + 1 h < t0 and T - 1 h >= window start; complete plausible 60-day core history required for all 11 samples, otherwise the whole group is excluded
features.daily: SPARTACUS RR and SNOWGRID (admitted in V0.4); day D valid at D+1 06:00 UTC; WINFORE not used (not admitted in V0.4)
features.same_day: missing (not 0 mm) unless time_quality is daypart or clock
features.land_cover: CORINE CLC2018 only if t0 >= 2019-01-01, else CLC2012 (V0.4 vintage rule; real-time availability not claimed)
features.geology: GeoSphere 1:500 000 lithology, five V0.4 classes; no mass-movement deposit classes
features.missing_values: conditional logit: a feature missing for any sample of a group is set to the training mean for all 11 samples, then standardised with training mean/sd; gradient boosting: native missing handling. Never invented values.
features.excluded_new_sources: no soil, soil moisture, finer geology or satellite features in V0.5

references.slope_rule: score = DEM slope (higher slope ranks higher), no fit

conditional_logit.standardize: training mean/sd after group missing mask
conditional_logit.converged: result.success, or (line-search abnormal termination AND max|gradient| <= 1e-4 * max(1, |objective|)); otherwise the run fails and no prediction is reported

models.training_weights: each event group weighted 1/sqrt(n), n = events of its V0.4 independence unit in the actual (purged) training set
models.no_tuning: no hyperparameter, seed or feature search

cross_validation.assignment: sorted retained V0.4 independence units, numpy default_rng(seed).permutation, numpy.array_split into 5 folds (V0.4 rule); identical for every model and variant
cross_validation.spatial_purge_primary: per outer fold remove every training independence unit that has any sample (any class) < 1000 m from any held-out sample (EPSG:31287); whole units removed; held-out groups unchanged; no control is redrawn
cross_validation.feasibility: every purged training set needs >= 5 independence units, >= 20 event groups and both classes; otherwise the registered plan is reported as not fully feasible (no substitute seed, no smaller distance, no silent switch to unpurged results)
cross_validation.unpurged_sensitivity: same outer folds without purge; clearly labelled sensitivity, never replaces the primary analysis
cross_validation.preprocessing: fit only on the actual (purged) fold training rows

metrics.primary_endpoint: conditional logit combined: mean within-group AUC weighted equally over V0.4 independence units (events equal within a unit), purged CV; reported as median and range over the 5 repetitions
metrics.primary_comparison: combined minus static, same conditional logit, same groups/folds/purge
metrics.top_k: a controls strictly higher, t tied: clip((k - a)/(t + 1), 0, 1), k in {1, 3}
metrics.mrr: mean over j = 0..t of 1/(1 + a + j)
metrics.no_accuracy: accuracy is never a primary metric; no thresholds; no absolute landslide probabilities

diagnostics.distributions: positive vs control: slope, elevation, aspect, CORINE class, lithology class; control distance bins 0.75-2, 2-5, 5-10 km
diagnostics.metadata_subsets: survey method, state, year, position category of the positives (evaluation metadata only), with event and unit counts
diagnostics.land_cover_ablation: conditional logit combined without the five lc_* columns, repetition 1, same folds/cohort/purge; described, never a new primary model
diagnostics.road_proximity: optional only if temporally suitable sourced data exist; not retrieved in V0.5 (would block)
diagnostics.stanz: the independence unit containing the 2016 Stanz storm reported separately; weighted evaluation with and without it from the same predictions
diagnostics.control_variants: common cohort of V0.5 retained groups: (a) 5 original V0.4 matched controls, (b) first 5 of the frozen unmatched sequence, (c) all 10 unmatched; conditional logit static and combined, repetition 1, same outer units; purge uses the union of all three variants' samples
diagnostics.border_indirect_cues: check that window edge / nodata / truncation flags do not separate positives from controls; flags are never predictors

stages: 1 -> 5 -> 20 event pilot (deterministic: events sorted by SHA-256('<event_id>|v05-pilot')) -> control and proximity audit of all 423 -> CV feasibility -> environmental features -> cohort and CV mapping frozen -> one technical pilot model -> registered main analysis -> report
pilot_rule: pilot metrics are code checks, not scientific results
